newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shares end off on technical correction.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shares end off on technical correction.

text.p: Brazil shares ended off 0.57 percent on a technical correction and were expected to open lower Friday on a continued lack of market-moving news, traders said.
"There was no news which could shake up the market. It was a boring day," a trader said.
The Bovespa index .BVSP of the 42 most traded shares closed down 379 points at 66,667 points. Turnover was moderate at 442.6 million reais ($430.3 million).

Bellwether Telebras preferred shares dropped 0.75 percent to close at 79.90 reais. Telebras receipts, which trade at a discount in the secondary market, jumped 16.44 percent to close at 44.48 reais on rumours that a Brazilian court could rule that Telebras must convert the receipts into shares at a later date, dealers said.

Power firm Eletrobras preferred shares ended down 0.31 percent at 326 reais. Mining giant Vale do Rio Doce preferred shares closed at 20.60 reais, up 0.49 percent. Oil monopoly Petrobras preferred shares fell 1.15 percent to close at 129 reais.
Sao Paulo bourse's power sector index comprising the nine most liquid stocks of the electrical sector (IEE) fell 2.32 percent to close at 1,774 points, a bourse spokeswoman said.
